title: Kissed Peruvian Lamb Seco de Cordero
description: A rich, flavorful Peruvian dish featuring tender lamb and a hint of Italian seasoning, perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Brown lamb in hot oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes, until browned on all sides.
Remove lamb from pot, and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in pot until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add oregano, thyme, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Return lamb to pot, and add wine, beef broth, and browned lamb. Cover and bring to a boil.
Transfer pot to preheated oven, and braise lamb for 2 hours, or until tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Remove lamb from pot, and shred it into bite-sized pieces.
Strain braising liquid through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan, discarding solids.
Simmer braising liquid over medium heat until reduced by half, about 10 minutes.
Return lamb to pot, and stir in sliced dates, if using.
Serve Seco de Cordero hot, garnished with additional oregano or thyme, if desired.
